images.title: Sierpinski Triangle: Steps 0, 1, 2
images.purpose: Shows the Sierpinski Triangle to Step 2 so the child sees remaining triangles multiply by 3.
images.composition: Plain white background with generous empty margins; the main object is large and centred and fills about 60 percent of the frame; nothing else is drawn. Three equal equilateral triangles, point up, in one horizontal row, evenly spaced, with a thin grey arrow between neighbours. Step names above, counts below.
images.exact_structure: Triangle A (left): one equilateral triangle filled green #009E73. Triangle B (middle), same size: the midpoints of its 3 sides are joined, making 4 equal small triangles; the 3 corner triangles are green, the upside down centre triangle is white (1 hole). Triangle C (right), same size: as B, and in each of the 3 green corner triangles the midpoints are joined again and its own centre is white; so 9 small green triangles remain, with 4 white holes (1 large, 3 small). Above: 'Step 0', 'Step 1', 'Step 2'. Below, amber #E69F00 bold: '1', '3', '9'. The two arrows carry no text; one amber label '× 3 each step' is centred under the row of counts.
rejection: any count of objects, cells, ticks or rows that differs from the numbers stated in the spec
any text beyond the listed visible text, or any listed text misspelled or altered
any board name, publisher name, book title, page number or curriculum branding anywhere in the frame
a hyphen used in place of a minus sign on any labelled number
images.takeaway: Each step keeps 3 of the 4 small triangles, so the triangles go 1, 3, 9.
images.description: Shows the Sierpinski Triangle to Step 2 so the child sees remaining triangles multiply by 3.
images.context: Concept T3.C3; one image that shows only the main idea.
images.teaching_notes: Holes at Step 2: 1 + 3 = 4. Area left at Step 2 is 9/16 of the start.

image_decisions.why: A practice concept with no tool; the image gives the drawing the child must reproduce and its counts.
